Name: BULLET_PARAM_ST
Description: Governs motion, hitbox and appearance of projetiles. Can reference AtkParam for damage.

Fields.Name: AtkParam ID
Fields.Description: The AtkParam row giving the bullet's damage and hit properties. The hit sphere comes from this bullet's Hit Radius fields, not from the AtkParam.

Fields.Name: Projectile SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect played on the bullet when it enters this state. -1: none. A parent with Is SFX Inherited by Child Bullet passes its effect on to its child.

Fields.Name: Impact SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect played where the bullet hits. -1: none. With Is Hit SFX Stuck to Target, it is attached to the character or object hit instead. Not played on character and object hits with Is SFX Disabled on Chr/Object Hit, or on water hits that are ignored.

Fields.Name: Repel SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect played instead of the impact effect when a character repels the bullet. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: How long the bullet lasts in this state, in seconds. Negative (-1): no time limit. Duration - Random Range adds a random extra time.

Fields.Name: Attenuation Range
Fields.Description: Distance in metres after which the bullet is out of range: the Out of Range gravity and acceleration apply and damage falloff starts (strictly past this distance). Scaled by the weapon's range bonus and range-up effects (see Range-Up Effect Multiplier). Also the aim distance when not locked on if Target Range when Unlocked is -1.

Fields.Name: Shoot Interval
Fields.Description: Seconds between volleys: the emitter fires Bullet Count bullets again every interval while it lasts. 0: fires once.

Fields.Name: Gravity: In Range
Fields.Description: Downward acceleration while within Attenuation Range, in m/s². Negative values push upward.

Fields.Name: Gravity: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Downward acceleration once past Attenuation Range, in m/s². Gives the drop at the end of a flight.

Fields.Name: Homing Stop Range
Fields.Description: Homing switches off for good once the bullet is within this many metres of the target, so it can be dodged up close. 0: homing never stops. While a flare effect is active, PlayerCommonParam's flare override stop range is used instead.

Fields.Name: Initial Velocity
Fields.Description: Starting speed in m/s. Also the preferred launch speed for howitzer bullets (Ballistic Calculation Type 1).

Fields.Name: Acceleration: In Range
Fields.Description: Acceleration along the flight direction while within Attenuation Range, in m/s². Negative slows the bullet. Starts only after Acceleration Delay.

Fields.Name: Acceleration: Out of Range
Fields.Description: Acceleration along the flight direction once past Attenuation Range, in m/s². Negative slows the bullet.

Fields.Name: Max Velocity
Fields.Description: Speed cap in m/s, applied after Min Velocity. 0 is a real cap (no speed), not "unlimited".

Fields.Name: Min Velocity
Fields.Description: Minimum speed in m/s. The speed is raised to this first, then capped by Max Velocity.

Fields.Name: Acceleration Delay
Fields.Description: Seconds after the bullet starts flying before acceleration applies (rocket-like spells). 0: accelerates at once.

Fields.Name: Homing Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance in metres the bullet travels before homing starts.

Fields.Name: Initial Hit Radius
Fields.Description: Radius of the hit sphere in metres when the bullet enters this state.

Fields.Name: Final Hit Radius
Fields.Description: Radius in metres the hit sphere grows to over Radius Spread Time. Negative (-1): stays at Initial Hit Radius.

Fields.Name: Radius Spread Time
Fields.Description: Seconds for the hit sphere to grow linearly from Initial to Final Hit Radius. While growing, the sphere is updated about six times a second. 0: no growth, the sphere stays at Initial Hit Radius.

Fields.Name: Expansion Delay
Fields.Description: Time from landing to expand (if 0, it expands immediately).

Fields.Name: Target Point Scatter
Fields.Description: Scatters the target point the bullets aim and home at: X and Z are each offset by a random amount within ± half this value, in metres, and the point stays fixed instead of tracking the target. 0: aim at the target itself. Applies with Follow Type 0, 3 or 4.

Fields.Name: Shared Hit List Duration
Fields.Description: Seconds the shared hit list lasts (see Is Use Shared Hit List; a bullet with an Attach Effect Type also gets one). While it lasts, a target already hit by the group can't be hit again by it. 0: the list doesn't time out.

Fields.Name: External Force in Bullet Direction
Fields.Description: Push added every frame along the initial horizontal shooting direction. It isn't scaled by frame time. Only values above 0 apply.

Fields.Name: Shooter SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the shooter each time the emitter fires a volley.

Fields.Name: Funnel Mode (Above 0)
Fields.Description: Any value above 0 makes this a funnel bullet: it registers with the funnel targeting system, and with Follow Type 1 it is placed in a ring around the shooter (Funnel Formation Radius and Height). For player shooters the funnel count comes from Intelligence (up to 14: 1, 15-18: 2, 19-24: 3, 25-30: 4, 31+: 5) unless Funnel Count Ignores Intelligence is on. Only "above 0" matters; the ID itself isn't used as an NpcThinkParam row.

Fields.Name: Hit Bullet ID
Fields.Description: Bullet spawned when this bullet hits or expires, if Launch Condition Type allows it. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [0]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to what the bullet hits, together with its attack. One of five slots. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [1]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to what the bullet hits, together with its attack. One of five slots. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [2]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to what the bullet hits, together with its attack. One of five slots. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [3]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to what the bullet hits, together with its attack. One of five slots. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Target SpEffect ID [4]
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to what the bullet hits, together with its attack. One of five slots. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Bullet Count
Fields.Description: Bullets fired at once per volley. Bullet i of the volley is turned by i × Launch Angle Interval and i × Launch Elevation Interval. For funnel bullets fired by players, Intelligence sets the count instead (see Funnel Mode).

Fields.Name: Homing Angle
Fields.Description: Maximum turn rate toward the target in degrees per second, once Homing Start Distance is reached. 0: no homing. While a flare effect is active, PlayerCommonParam's flare override angle is used instead.

Fields.Name: Launch Angle
Fields.Description: Horizontal launch angle in degrees, added to the aim direction. Only for Emitter Source Type 0 and 2.

Fields.Name: Launch Angle Interval
Fields.Description: Extra horizontal angle per bullet in a volley, in degrees: bullet i fires at Launch Angle + i × this value.

Fields.Name: Launch Elevation Interval
Fields.Description: Extra elevation per bullet in a volley, in degrees: bullet i fires at Launch Elevation Angle + i × this value.

Fields.Name: Attack Decay 8 [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the eighth multiplier of the bullet's attack (what it scales is not established).

Fields.Name: Unknown: Second Attack Value
Fields.Description: When above 0 and the bullet does not pass through map geometry, a second attack record carrying this value is registered for the bullet. Its effect is not established. Retail: -1, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2 or 0.5.

Fields.Name: Launch Elevation Angle
Fields.Description: Launch elevation in degrees above the horizontal (-90 to 90). Only for Emitter Source Type 0 and 2.

Fields.Name: Lock Direction Limit Angle
Fields.Description: At launch, the bullet turns toward the target by at most this many degrees. 0: no turn toward the target.

Fields.Name: Previous Velocity Direction Rate
Fields.Description: For ground-hugging bullets (Follow Type 4) that hit a wall: percent of the previous direction mixed into the new one, so the bullet slides along.

Fields.Name: Attack Attribute
Fields.Description: Overrides the attack's physical damage type. 254: keep the AtkParam's value.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: Overrides the attack's special attribute. 254: keep the AtkParam's value.

Fields.Name: Material Attack Type
Fields.Description: Overrides the attack type used for hit sounds and effects. 254: keep the attack's value.

Fields.Name: Material Attack Material
Fields.Description: Overrides the attack material used for hit sounds and effects. 254: keep the attack's value.

Fields.Name: Is Penetrate Character
Fields.Description: On: the bullet passes through characters instead of ending on them. It still damages them.

Fields.Name: Is Penetrate Object
Fields.Description: On: the bullet passes through dynamic and breakable assets instead of ending on them. Static assets count as map (Is Penetrate Map).

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Line of Sight
Fields.Description: Set: a target only counts for the multi-target search when a ray from the shooter to the target is not blocked. Retail: set on Fan Daggers, Omen Bairn wraiths and Glintstone Scrap.

Fields.Name: Launch Condition Type
Fields.Description: When the Hit Bullet ID child spawns: 0 and 3 always (hit or expiry); 1 on water; 2 on water or swamp; 4 on a character hit or on expiry; 5 on a map or object hit; 6 when absorbed (Attach Effect Type 5); above 6 never. Read from the bullet's current state.

Fields.Name: Follow Type
Fields.Description: What the bullet moves with. 0: nothing. 1: the shooter's dummy poly. 2: the shooter's feet, one-to-one. 3: the target point (the lock-on target, or the aim point ahead). 4: nothing; the bullet hugs the ground instead. 5: the middle of the shooter's body.

Fields.Name: Emitter Source Type
Fields.Description: Where the bullet is created. 0: the shooter's dummy poly. 1: around the shooter (Emitter Source Radius). 2: the dummy poly with a level orientation (meteors). 3: at or near the target. 4: around the nearest enemy (Emitter Source Radius). 5: the parent bullet, for chained bullets. 6: a stored placement. Shot angles apply only to 0 and 2.

Fields.Name: Is Hit SFX Stuck to Target
Fields.Description: On: on a character or object hit, the Impact SFX is attached to what was hit and stays with it (arrows stuck in a target). The impact sound and Asset Generated on Hit are then skipped. Map hits are unchanged.

Fields.Name: Is Continuous Hit
Fields.Description: Sets the continuous-hit flag on the bullet's attack hits. Its exact effect isn't established.

Fields.Name: Is Penetrate Map
Fields.Description: On: the bullet passes through the map and static assets instead of ending on them. The floor still stops it.

Fields.Name: Is Hit Both Teams
Fields.Description: Are you an enemy or an ally? (Not a wandering ghost)

Fields.Name: Is Use Shared Hit List
Fields.Description: On: all bullets of this ID fired by one emitter (a volley, or repeated volleys) share one hit list, so each target is hit once by the whole group. The list lasts for Shared Hit List Duration.

Fields.Name: Use Multiple Dummy Polys for Placement
Fields.Description: Do you use the same Damipoly ID more than once when placing bullets?

Fields.Name: Is Erased by Erase Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is ended, with its hit effect, by bullets with Attach Effect Type 4 (Erase Bullets).

Fields.Name: Is Absorbed by Absorb Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is absorbed by bullets with Attach Effect Type 5: it ends without its hit effect and counts as absorbed (Launch Condition Type 6).

Fields.Name: Is Pushed by Force Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is pushed away by bullets with Attach Effect Type 1 (wind barriers and similar).

Fields.Name: Ignore Map Hits After Water
Fields.Description: On: from the first time the bullet touches water, its map hits play no impact effect, sound or asset, spawn no Hit Bullet ID and don't end it.

Fields.Name: Ignore Water Surface Hits
Fields.Description: On: a hit on a water surface is ignored: no impact effect, sound or asset, no Hit Bullet ID, and the bullet carries on. Leave off for bullets that should react to water (Launch Condition Type 1 or 2).

Fields.Name: Is Pushed by Dark Force Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is pushed away by bullets with Attach Effect Type 3 (magic-repelling barriers).

Fields.Name: Damage Calculation Side
Fields.Description: Meant to choose which player's machine computes the damage in multiplayer. It is copied into the bullet's attack, but no effect was found.

Fields.Name: Is Auto Homing Enabled
Fields.Description: On: when the shooter isn't locked on, the bullet picks a target by itself.

Fields.Name: Recalculate Placement for Synced Bullets
Fields.Description: For bullets created through network sync: On recalculates the placement from the shooter's dummy poly instead of using the synced emitter placement.

Fields.Name: Child Uses Shooter's Direction
Fields.Description: Set on a chained bullet: On takes its starting direction from the shooting character instead of the parent bullet.

Fields.Name: Is SFX Inherited by Child Bullet
Fields.Description: Set on the parent: its chained bullet takes over the parent's bullet effect.

Fields.Name: Damage Falloff %: Holy
Fields.Description: Past Attenuation Range, holy damage drops by this many percent per second, down to 0.

Fields.Name: Bullet SFX Delete Type - By Hit
Fields.Description: How the bullet effect ends when the bullet hits and ends: 0 stops its emitter (existing particles finish), 1 deletes it.

Fields.Name: Bullet SFX Delete Type - By Expiration
Fields.Description: How the bullet effect ends when Duration runs out: 0 stops its emitter (existing particles finish), 1 deletes it.

Fields.Name: Target Vertical Offset
Fields.Description: Raises the target point by this many metres at launch and during homing (negative lowers it). A fixed offset, not a random range.

Fields.Name: Random Launch Angle - Max
Fields.Description: Random horizontal spread in degrees: each bullet's angle varies by up to ± half this value.

Fields.Name: Random Elevation Angle - Max
Fields.Description: Random elevation spread in degrees: each bullet's elevation varies by up to ± half this value.

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Bullet ID
Fields.Description: Bullet spawned again and again at this bullet's position while it lasts (trails, drips). -1: off. Needs Interval Bullet: Max Interval other than 0.

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Min Interval
Fields.Description: Shortest gap between interval spawns, in seconds. Each gap is random between Min and Max.

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Max Interval
Fields.Description: Longest gap between interval spawns, in seconds. 0 turns interval spawning off.

Fields.Name: Prediction Shoot Observe Time
Fields.Description: Leads the target: the aim uses the target's average velocity over this many seconds. 0: no lead.

Fields.Name: Interval Bullet: Start Delay
Fields.Description: Seconds after the bullet is created before interval spawning starts.

Fields.Name: SFX Posture Type
Fields.Description: Orientation given to effects and chained bullets created from this bullet. 0: the bullet's own. 1: levelled (world up); also levels the launch. 2: the normal of the surface hit.

Fields.Name: Create Limit Group ID
Fields.Description: Group for a shared cap set in BulletCreateLimitParam: when the group is at its limit, the oldest bullet in it is removed and the new one is still created. 0: no group.

Fields.Name: Is Speed Inherited by Child Bullet
Fields.Description: Set on the parent: its chained bullet starts at the parent's current speed instead of its own Initial Velocity.

Fields.Name: Is SFX Disabled on Chr/Object Hit
Fields.Description: On: no impact effect, impact sound or hit asset when the bullet hits a character or object. Map hits still play them.

Fields.Name: Is Wall Checked by Center Ray
Fields.Description: There was a problem with the digging judgment when firing a bullet, so it is for error handling. SEQ23101 [Own character] If you use a soul short arrow or a strong soul short arrow in close contact with a character with a high lock-on position, the direction of the bullet will be reversed.

Fields.Name: Is Ended by Flare Fields
Fields.Description: On: the bullet is ended by bullets with Attach Effect Type 2 (Flare), such as the moon spells.

Fields.Name: Is Bullet Wall Filter Used
Fields.Description: On: the bullet's map checks use a different collision filter (meant for collision that only bullets see).

Fields.Name: Funnel Count Ignores Intelligence
Fields.Description: On: funnel bullets fired by players use Bullet Count instead of the Intelligence-based count (see Funnel Mode).

Fields.Name: AI Reacts Even Without Damage
Fields.Description: On: enemy AI notices this bullet even when its attack deals no damage. Without it, only damaging bullets are noticed.

Fields.Name: Emitter Source Radius
Fields.Description: Radius in metres for Emitter Source Type 1 (around the shooter) and 4 (around the nearest enemy).

Fields.Name: Funnel Formation Height
Fields.Description: Funnel bullets with Follow Type 1: height in metres of the ring they're placed in around the shooter.

Fields.Name: Asset Generated on Hit
Fields.Description: Asset created where the bullet hits, with the impact effect. The number is the asset name's digits: AEG999_999 = 999999. -1 or 0: none.

Fields.Name: Duration - Random Range
Fields.Description: Adds a random 0 to this many seconds to Duration. Only when Duration isn't negative.

Fields.Name: Homing Angle: X
Fields.Description: Only the X-axis component of the inductive performance is changed. Do not change with -1

Fields.Name: Ballistic Calculation Type
Fields.Description: 0: the bullet is fired along the aim. 1: howitzer: the launch elevation and speed are solved to arc onto the target, within the Howitzer limits; uses Gravity: In Range.

Fields.Name: Attach Effect Type
Fields.Description: A field this bullet puts on other bullets while it flies. 1 pushes away, 2 ends, 3 pushes away, 4 erases, 5 absorbs, 6 remotely detonates. Only bullets with the matching flag are affected (Is Pushed by Force Fields, Is Ended by Flare Fields, Is Pushed by Dark Force Fields, Is Erased by Erase Fields, Is Absorbed by Absorb Fields, Can be Remotely Detonated).

Fields.Name: Projectile SE ID [1]
Fields.Description: Sound played on the bullet when it enters this state (sound type s). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Projectile SE ID [2]
Fields.Description: Second sound played on the bullet when it enters this state (sound type s). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Impact SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played where the bullet hits (sound type s). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Repel SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound played when a character repels the bullet (sound type s). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Howitzer - Launch Elevation Limit - Min
Fields.Description: Howitzer bullets: lowest launch elevation in degrees, relative to the base aim pitch (clamped to ±90).

Fields.Name: Howitzer - Launch Elevation Limit - Max
Fields.Description: Howitzer bullets: highest launch elevation in degrees, relative to the base aim pitch (clamped to ±90).

Fields.Name: Howitzer - Initial Min Velocity
Fields.Description: Howitzer bullets: lowest launch speed in m/s the arc solver may use.

Fields.Name: Howitzer - Initial Max Velocity
Fields.Description: Howitzer bullets: highest launch speed in m/s the arc solver may use.

Fields.Name: Force Erase SFX ID
Fields.Description: Effect played when the bullet is ended or absorbed by another bullet's field. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Bullet SFX Delete Type - By Force Erase
Fields.Description: How the bullet effect ends when the bullet is absorbed by another bullet's field: 0 stops its emitter (existing particles finish), 1 deletes it.

Fields.Name: SFX Orientation Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: While the bullet flies, its orientation is taken from this dummy poly on the shooting character. -1: off.

Fields.Name: Funnel Formation Radius
Fields.Description: Funnel bullets with Follow Type 1: radius in metres of the ring they're placed in around the shooter.

Fields.Name: Range-Up Effect Multiplier
Fields.Description: While the shooter has a range-up SpEffect (state info 444), the effective Attenuation Range is multiplied by this.

Fields.Name: Target Range when Unlocked
Fields.Description: When not locked on, the bullet aims at a point this many metres ahead. -1: use Attenuation Range. 0: no target point.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Max Distance
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: targets are searched within this distance (m) of the search origin. 0: no target qualifies (retail 0 on all but 142 rows, e.g. Fan Daggers 25, Glintstone Scrap 15).

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Horizontal Angle 1
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: largest horizontal angle (degrees) from the shooter's facing for targets on one side; the other side uses Horizontal Angle 2. Retail 45, 90 or 180.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Horizontal Angle 2
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: largest horizontal angle (degrees) from the shooter's facing for targets on the other side from Horizontal Angle 1. Retail usually equal to it (40 vs 90 on one enemy bullet).

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Vertical Angle 1
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: largest vertical angle (degrees) for targets on one side of the horizontal (below, by the sign test); the other side uses Vertical Angle 2. Retail always equal to Vertical Angle 2.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Vertical Angle 2
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: largest vertical angle (degrees) for targets on the other side of the horizontal (above, by the sign test). Retail always equal to Vertical Angle 1.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Origin Back Offset
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: the search origin is moved this far (m) behind the shooter, along its facing, before distances and angles are measured. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Search: Min Distance
Fields.Description: Multi-target shot: targets closer than this distance (m) to the search origin are skipped. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Aim Angle 1
Fields.Description: Angle (degrees) used when the shot picks which of the found multi-target targets to aim at; how it is applied is not established. Retail 5 on 65 rows, 4 on Fan Daggers.

Fields.Name: Multi-Target Aim Angle 2
Fields.Description: Second angle (degrees) used with Multi-Target Aim Angle 1 when picking a found target to aim at; how it is applied is not established. Retail 45 on Fan Daggers only.
Copied from the bullet's current row into a hit-related record together with the owner's data; its effect is not established. −1 on almost every row; 0, 10, 20 or 50 on a few enemy bullets.

Fields.Name: Physical Attack Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: While the bullet flies, its physical attack multiplier (starts at 100%) drops by this many percent per second, down to 0. Retail 420 on arrows (gone after about 0.24 s), 300 on greatarrows.

Fields.Name: Magic Attack Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the bullet's magic attack.

Fields.Name: Fire Attack Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the bullet's fire attack.

Fields.Name: Lightning Attack Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the bullet's lightning attack.

Fields.Name: Holy Attack Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the bullet's holy attack.

Fields.Name: Stamina Attack Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the bullet's stamina attack (stamina damage dealt to a guarding target).

Fields.Name: Knockback Decay [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the bullet's knockback. Retail 100 on arrows, where the attack decays are 420.

Fields.Name: Attack Decay 9 [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the ninth multiplier of the bullet's attack (what it scales is not established). Retail 294 on arrows (70% of the others).

Fields.Name: Attack Decay 10 [%/s]
Fields.Description: As Physical Attack Decay, for the tenth multiplier of the bullet's attack (what it scales is not established). Retail 420 on arrows.
